# Fibich

> Fibich is a native macOS music player for organizing and playing a local music library.

Fibich purchases are temporarily paused while a few details are polished.

## Official pages

- Website: https://fibich.app/
- License use: https://fibich.app/license.html
- Privacy notice: https://fibich.app/privacy.html
- Open-source software: https://fibich.app/legal/open-source/
- Complete third-party notices: https://fibich.app/legal/open-source/ThirdPartyNotices.txt
- Version-specific source materials: https://fibich.app/legal/open-source/source/SOURCE-CONTENTS.txt
- Product screenshot: https://fibich.app/assets/fibich_appMock-dark.png
- Creator: Antonin Charvat, https://www.linkedin.com/in/antonincharvat/

## Product facts

- Product name: Fibich
- Category: Music player
- Supported platform: macOS 15 or later
- Availability: Purchases temporarily paused
- License: One perpetual license for one Mac at a time
- Additional Macs: A separate license is required for each additional Mac
- Transfers: Reinstallation on the same Mac is allowed, and a license may be moved after use on the previous Mac ends
- Refunds and payment reversals: A full refund or successful payment reversal terminates the license; the customer must stop using Fibich and delete the key
- Chargeback reversals: A successful chargeback reversal restores the license unless another terminating adjustment still applies
